build_ms_marco_data: build the MS MARCO dataset by downloading and converting train, valid, and test splits
convert_gzip_to_records: convert a gzipped MS MARCO JSON file into a generator of query-passage record dictionaries
create_fb_format_files: create Parlai fbformat text and passage selection files from a gzipped MS MARCO data file
cleanup_passage_text: cleanup passage text by stripping whitespace and replacing pipes and newlines with safe tokens
read_file_lines: read all lines from a file using PathManager and return them as a list
